scenicChapters.title: Watchtowers WP 15/8 to 15/10 → Fort site of Burgsalach
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 39 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-fort-site-and-civil-settlement-of.story: From Neustadt an der Donau it runs 184 km to Neustadt an der Donau; allow about 3 h 10 of riding. The stops in between: Watchtowers WP 15/8 to 15/10, Fort site of Burgsalach, fort site and civil settlement of Theilenh and back through Fort site of Burgsalach. The line favours views over speed.
